question: In forward osmosis, why did replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increase the water flux?
rendered: The excerpts do not indicate that replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increased the water flux. Instead, they state that substituting deionized water with real municipal wastewater reduced the water flux by 8.1-46.2% depending on draw solution chemistry.
